dr.titel.hijack: %2 wants to snatch %1 just before the signing
dr.titel.verhandlung.berater_verzoegert: The agent of %1 keeps us waiting
dr.titel.verhandlung.letzter_moment: The deal for %1 collapses at the last moment
dr.titel.deadline: Deadline day: the clock is ticking
dr.text.medizin.auffaellig: The club doctor found something with %1: the risk that he keeps missing games is %2 percent. You can renegotiate the price, sign anyway or call the move off. If you do not answer, we pull out.
dr.text.medizin.bestanden: The club doctor gives the green light for %1. Health-wise nothing stands in the way of the signing (injury risk %2 percent).
dr.text.medizin.durchgefallen: The club doctor strongly advises against %1 (injury risk %2 percent). The move has collapsed.
dr.text.nachforderung: At the last moment the agent of %1 demands more money, or the signing falls through. The price would rise to %2. Pay, negotiate or refuse.
dr.text.hijack: Just before the signing %2 raised the stakes for %1 and bid %3. If you outbid with %4 the player stays with us. Otherwise he goes to the rival.
dr.text.verhandlung.berater_verzoegert: The other side has not yet replied about %1 and asks for more time. No answer is expected before %3.
dr.text.verhandlung.hijack: In the middle of our talks %2 made an offer for %1. The seller sets a deadline of %3: whoever has not closed by then goes away empty-handed.
dr.text.verhandlung.verein_abbruch: Without warning %2 ended the negotiations about %1 and gives no explanation.
dr.text.verhandlung.letzter_moment: Shortly before the signing everything fell apart: the sides no longer find each other, the move of %1 will not happen.
dr.text.deadline: The transfer window closes today. Every other side wants to answer before the deadline, afterwards every open deal is dead. %1 negotiations are running.
dr.text.streik.1: %1 is unhappy and shows it in training. Talk to him before it gets worse.
dr.text.streik.2: %1 no longer turns up for sessions and does not train until things are sorted out. The board and the press are watching closely.
dr.text.streik.3: %1 refuses to play. He is not available for selection until things are sorted out.
dr.text.vertrag: The agent lets it be known: %1 will only extend for %2 a year. %3 is interested.
dr.text.vertrag.laeuft: The extension for %1 is on the negotiating table. The poker stays open until it is signed.
dr.text.vertrag.ausgesessen: You let the matter of %1 rest. The deadline keeps running and the player grows impatient.
dr.opt.streik.zusage: Promise a release in the next window
dr.opt.streik.verkauf: Put the player up for sale
dr.opt.vertrag.verkaufen: Sell while there is still a fee
dr.folge.medizin.nachverhandeln.1: The club may grant a discount of up to %2 percent
dr.folge.medizin.nachverhandeln.2: If it refuses, only signing or calling off remain
dr.folge.medizin.abbrechen.1: The player stays where he is
dr.folge.nachforderung.verhandeln.1: If it works, the price only rises by half as much
dr.folge.nachforderung.verhandeln.2: Otherwise the agent walks away and the move collapses
dr.folge.hijack.verzichten.1: The player goes to the rival
dr.folge.streik.gespraech.1: Can ease the situation by one level
dr.folge.streik.gespraech.2: Not every conversation helps, afterwards he rests for three days
dr.folge.streik.zusage.2: If you break your word it gets worse than before
dr.folge.streik.verkauf.2: He trains again until a buyer is found
dr.folge.streik.strafe.2: Only works on followers, not on leaders
dr.folge.vertrag.verlaengern.2: The poker ends as soon as he signs
dr.folge.vertrag.aussitzen.1: After the deadline on %2 he may leave on a free transfer
dr.grund.gespraech: He does not want to talk again before %1.
dr.ui.deadline.zeit: The window closes today. Afterwards every open deal is dead.
dr.ui.react.vorstand.2: The board expects you to get the boycott under control.
dr.ui.react.vorstand.3: The board demands a solution, the club's reputation is suffering.
dr.ui.react.medien.2: The press asks how the coach deals with the boycott.
dr.ui.react.medien.3: The papers turn the case into a headline.
dr.ui.react.fans.3: The fans whistle and demand a decision.
wartet.poker.0: The agent is phoning the competition …
wartet.poker.1: The player weighs up his offer …
wartet.poker.2: The demand lies on the desk in the office …
